name: description
label: Description
help: Leave it empty to keep the current description, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: path
label: Folder
help: The folder where uploads land. Leave it empty to keep the current folder.

name: password
label: Password
help: Leave it empty to keep the current password, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: expiresAt
label: Expires at
help: Leave it empty to keep the current date, or map `erase` so that the file request never expires.

name: maxFileSize
label: Maximum file size (bytes)
help: Leave it empty to keep the current limit, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: allowedFileTypes
label: Allowed file extensions
help: The file extensions senders can upload. Leave it empty to keep the current list, or map `erase` to accept every type.

name: maxUploads
label: Maximum uploads
help: Leave it empty to keep the current limit, or map `erase` to remove it.

name: visitorIdentity
label: Ask senders who they are
help: Ask senders for their name and email.

name: active
label: Active
help: Turn it off to close the file request, or on to reopen it.
